verses.original: וּמִקְנֶ֣ה׀ רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְאֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַמָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·neh raḇ hā·yāh liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên wə·liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ ‘ā·ṣūm mə·’ōḏ way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ ya‘·zêr wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ gil·‘āḏ wə·hin·nêh ham·mā·qō·wm mə·qō·wm miq·neh
verses.literal: Now the Reubenites . . . and Gadites . . . who had very large herds and flocks surveyed the lands of Jazer - and Gilead and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock
verses.literalPt: E OS filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade tinham gado em grande quantidade; e viram a terra de Jazer, e a terra de Gileade, e eis que o lugar era lugar de gado.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ בְנֵֽי־ גָ֖ד וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên way·yō·mə·rū ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·’el- nə·śî·’ê hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: So the Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . came to Moses . . . Eleazar the priest . . . and the leaders of the congregation and said
verses.literalPt: Vieram, pois, os filhos de Gade, e os filhos de Rúben e falaram a Moisés e a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e aos chefes da congregação, dizendo:

verses.original: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּשְׂבָ֥ם וּנְב֖וֹ וּבְעֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ wə·ḏî·ḇōn wə·ya‘·zêr wə·nim·rāh wə·ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’el·‘ā·lêh ū·śə·ḇām ū·nə·ḇōw ū·ḇə·‘ōn
verses.literal: Ataroth Dibon Jazer Nimrah Heshbon Elealeh Sebam Nebo and Beon
verses.literalPt: Atarote, e Dibom, e Jazer, e Ninra, e Hesbom, e Eleale, e Sebã, e Nebo, e Beom,

verses.original: הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְלַֽעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מִקְנֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hik·kāh Yah·weh lip̄·nê ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’e·reṣ miq·neh hî wə·la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā miq·neh
verses.literal: which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel are suitable for livestock . . . and your servants have livestock
verses.literalPt: A terra que o SENHOR feriu diante da congregação de Israel, é terra para gado, e os teus servos têm gado.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִם־ מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל־ תַּעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’im- mā·ṣā·nū ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā yut·tan ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh ’al- ta·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: If we have found favor in your sight they said let this land be given to your servants as a possession Do not make us cross the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Disseram mais: Se achamos graça aos teus olhos, dê-se esta terra aos teus servos em possessão; e não nos faças passar o Jordão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד וְלִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַאַֽחֵיכֶ֗ם יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ wə·liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên ha·’a·ḥê·ḵem yā·ḇō·’ū lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·’at·tem tê·šə·ḇū p̄ōh
verses.literal: But Moses asked the Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here
verses.literalPt: Porém Moisés disse aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben: Irão vossos irmãos à peleja, e ficareis vós aqui?

verses.original: וְלָ֣מָּה תְנוּאוּן אֶת־ לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽעֲבֹר֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lām·māh ṯə·nū·ʾūn ’eṯ- lêḇ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ă·ḇōr ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan lā·hem Yah·weh
verses.literal: Why are you discouraging - the Israelites . . . from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them
verses.literalPt: Por que, pois, desencorajais o coração dos filhos de Israel, para que não passem à terra que o SENHOR lhes tem dado?

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּשָׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ‘ā·śū ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem bə·šā·lə·ḥî ’ō·ṯām miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land
verses.literalPt: Assim fizeram vossos pais, quando os mandei de Cades-Barnéia, a ver esta terra.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ עַד־ נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת־ לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְבִלְתִּי־ בֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ‘aḏ- na·ḥal ’eš·kō·wl way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·nî·’ū ’eṯ- lêḇ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇil·tî- ḇō ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan lā·hem Yah·weh
verses.literal: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land they discouraged - the Israelites . . . from entering . . . the land that the LORD had given them
verses.literalPt: Chegando eles até ao vale de Escol, e vendo esta terra, desencorajaram o coração dos filhos de Israel, para que não entrassem na terra que o SENHOR lhes tinha dado.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lê·mōr
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day and He swore an oath saying
verses.literalPt: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu naquele mesmo dia, e jurou dizendo:

verses.original: אִם־ יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה אֵ֚ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י לֹא־ מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yir·’ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·‘ō·lîm mim·miṣ·ra·yim mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh ’êṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî lō- mil·’ū ’a·ḥă·rāy
verses.literal: Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly not one of the men twenty years of age . . . or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham Isaac and Jacob
verses.literalPt: Que os homens, que subiram do Egito, de vinte anos para cima, não verão a terra que jurei a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó! porquanto não perseveraram em seguir-me;

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן כִּ֥י מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bil·tî kā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh haq·qə·niz·zî wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn kî mil·’ū ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly
verses.literalPt: Exceto Calebe, filho de Jefoné o quenezeu, e Josué, filho de Num, porquanto perseveraram em seguir ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְנִעֵם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־ תֹּם֙ כָּל־ הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·ni·‘êm bam·miḏ·bār ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ‘aḏ- tōm kāl- had·dō·wr hā·‘ō·śeh hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone
verses.literalPt: Assim se acendeu a ira do SENHOR contra Israel, e fê-los andar errantes pelo deserto quarenta anos até que se consumiu toda aquela geração, que fizera mal aos olhos do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים לִסְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh qam·tem ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem tar·būṯ ’ă·nā·šîm ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm lis·pō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ ‘al ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh ’el- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now behold you, a brood of sinners have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke . . . the burning anger of the LORD against Israel
verses.literalPt: E eis que vós, uma geração de homens pecadores, vos levantastes em lugar de vossos pais, para ainda mais acrescentar o furor da ira do SENHOR contra Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻן֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו וְיָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְהַנִּיח֖וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְכָל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ṯə·šū·ḇun mê·’a·ḥă·rāw wə·yā·sap̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·han·nî·ḥōw bam·miḏ·bār wə·ši·ḥat·tem lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām haz·zeh
verses.literal: For if you turn away from following Him He will once again . . . leave this people in the wilderness and you will be the cause of their destruction . . .
verses.literalPt: Se vós vos virardes de segui-lo, também ele os deixará de novo no deserto, e destruireis a todo este povo.

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַ֣יֹּאמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū ’ê·lāw way·yō·mə·rū giḏ·rōṯ ṣōn niḇ·neh lə·miq·nê·nū pōh wə·‘ā·rîm lə·ṭap·pê·nū
verses.literal: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said We want to build sheepfolds . . . here for our livestock and cities for our little ones
verses.literalPt: Então chegaram-se a ele, e disseram: Edificaremos currais aqui para o nosso gado, e cidades para as nossas crianças;

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם־ הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל־ מְקוֹמָ֑ם וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֙נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·naḥ·nū nê·ḥā·lêṣ ḥu·šîm lip̄·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ ’ă·šer ’im- hă·ḇî·’ō·num ’el- mə·qō·w·mām wə·yā·šaḇ ṭap·pê·nū bə·‘ā·rê ham·miḇ·ṣār mip·pə·nê yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites . . . until - we have brought them into their place Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land
verses.literalPt: Porém nós nos armaremos, apressando-nos adiante dos de Israel, até que os levemos ao seu lugar; e ficarão as nossas crianças nas cidades fortes por causa dos moradores da terra.

verses.original: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־ בָּתֵּ֑ינוּ עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō nā·šūḇ ’el- bāt·tê·nū ‘aḏ hiṯ·na·ḥêl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite . . . has taken possession of his inheritance
verses.literalPt: Não voltaremos para nossas casas, até que os filhos de Israel estejam de posse, cada um, da sua herança.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî lō nin·ḥal ’it·tām mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên wā·hā·lə·’āh kî ḇā·’āh na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ’ê·lê·nū mê·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên miz·rā·ḥāh
verses.literal: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond because . . . our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Porque não herdaremos com eles além do Jordão, nem mais adiante; porquanto nós já temos a nossa herança aquém do Jordão, ao oriente.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּן אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה אִם־ תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mō·šeh ’im- ta·‘ă·śūn ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’im- tê·ḥā·lə·ṣū lip̄·nê Yah·weh lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Moses replied If you will do - this if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés lhes disse: Se isto fizerdes assim, se vos armardes à guerra perante o SENHOR;

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם כָּל־ חָל֛וּץ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛וֹ אֶת־ אֹיְבָ֖יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar lā·ḵem kāl- ḥā·lūṣ ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘aḏ hō·w·rî·šōw ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇāw mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD until He has driven His enemies out before Him
verses.literalPt: E cada um de vós, armado, passar o Jordão perante o SENHOR, até que haja lançado fora os seus inimigos de diante dele,

verses.original: וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִהְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵיְהוָ֖ה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠הָיְתָה הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֥את לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niḵ·bə·šāh hā·’ā·reṣ lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·’a·ḥar tā·šu·ḇū wih·yî·ṯem nə·qî·yîm Yah·weh ū·mî·yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·yə·ṯāh hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lā·ḵem la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: then when the land is subdued before the LORD you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E a terra esteja subjugada perante o SENHOR; então voltareis e sereis inculpáveis perante o SENHOR e perante Israel; e esta terra vos será por possessão perante o SENHOR;

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וּדְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯa·‘ă·śūn kên hin·nêh ḥă·ṭā·ṯem Yah·weh ū·ḏə·‘ū ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem ’ă·šer tim·ṣā ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: But if you do not do this you will certainly sin against the LORD and be assured that your sin will find you out
verses.literalPt: E se não fizerdes assim, eis que pecastes contra o SENHOR; e sabei que o vosso pecado vos há de achar.

verses.original: בְּנֽוּ־ לָכֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nū- lā·ḵem ‘ā·rîm lə·ṭap·pə·ḵem ū·ḡə·ḏê·rōṯ lə·ṣō·na·’ă·ḵem wə·hay·yō·ṣê mip·pî·ḵem ta·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks but do what you have promised . . .
verses.literalPt: Edificai cidades para as vossas crianças, e currais para as vossas ovelhas; e fazei o que saiu da vossa boca.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי־ גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ya·‘ă·śū ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḏō·nî mə·ṣaw·weh
verses.literal: The Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . said to Moses . . . Your servants will do just as our lord commands
verses.literalPt: Então falaram os filhos de Gade, e os filhos de Rúben a Moisés, dizendo: Como ordena meu senhor, assim farão teus servos.

verses.original: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ־ שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ṭap·pê·nū nā·šê·nū miq·nê·nū wə·ḵāl bə·hem·tê·nū yih·yū- šām bə·‘ā·rê hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Our children our wives our livestock and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead
verses.literalPt: As nossas crianças, as nossas mulheres, o nosso gado, e todos os nossos animais estarão aí nas cidades de Gileade.

verses.original: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כָּל־ חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י דֹּבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ya·‘aḇ·rū kāl- ḥă·lūṣ ṣā·ḇā lip̄·nê Yah·weh lam·mil·ḥā·māh ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḏō·nî dō·ḇêr
verses.literal: But your servants are equipped for war and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD just as our lord says
verses.literalPt: Mas os teus servos passarão, cada um armado para a guerra, a pelejar perante o SENHOR, como tem falado o meu SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו לָהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן וְאֶת־ רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw lā·hem mō·šeh ’êṯ ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·’êṯ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·’eṯ- rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·wṯ ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest to Joshua son of Nun and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés deu ordem acerca deles a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Num, e aos cabeças das casas dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִם־ יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי־ גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי־ רְאוּבֵ֣ן׀ אִ֠תְּכֶם אֶֽת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן כָּל־ חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’ă·lê·hem ’im- ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên ’it·tə·ḵem ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên kāl- ḥā·lūṣ lam·mil·ḥā·māh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·niḵ·bə·šāh hā·’ā·reṣ lip̄·nê·ḵem ū·nə·ṯat·tem lā·hem ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh
verses.literal: And Moses said to them If the Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . cross the Jordan with you with every man armed for battle before the LORD and the land is subdued before you then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Se os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben passarem convosco o Jordão, armado cada um para a guerra, perante o SENHOR, e a terra estiver subjugada diante de vós, em possessão lhes dareis a terra de Gileade.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְנֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְתֹכְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ya·‘aḇ·rū ḥă·lū·ṣîm ’it·tə·ḵem wə·nō·ḥă·zū ḇə·ṯō·ḵə·ḵɛm bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: Porém, se não passarem armados convosco, terão possessões entre vós, na terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי־ גָ֛ד וּבְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nū ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên lê·mōr ’êṯ ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā kên na·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: The Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . . . . replied As the LORD has spoken to your servants so we will do
verses.literalPt: E responderam os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, dizendo: O que o SENHOR falou a teus servos, isso faremos.

verses.original: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאִתָּ֙נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔נוּ מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: naḥ·nū na·‘ă·ḇōr ḥă·lū·ṣîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wə·’it·tā·nū ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên
verses.literal: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD that we may have our inheritance . . . on this side of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Nós passaremos, armados, perante o SENHOR, à terra de Canaã, e teremos a possessão de nossa herança aquém do Jordão.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֣ם׀ מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִבְנֵי־ גָד֩ וְלִבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְלַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט׀ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־ מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֶת־ מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן הָאָ֗רֶץ לְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּגְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lā·hem mō·šeh liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ wə·liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên wə·la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh ḇen- yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- mam·le·ḵeṯ sî·ḥōn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’eṯ- mam·le·ḵeṯ ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān hā·’ā·reṣ lə·‘ā·re·hā biḡ·ḇu·lōṯ ‘ā·rê hā·’ā·reṣ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: So Moses gave to the Gadites . . . to the Reubenites . . . and to the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim deu-lhes Moisés, aos filhos de Gade, e aos filhos de Rúben, e à meia tribo de Manassés, filho de José, o reino de Siom, rei dos amorreus, e o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã; a terra com as suas cidades nos seus termos, e as cidades ao seu redor.

verses.original: וַיִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי־ גָ֔ד אֶת־ דִּיבֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ עֲטָרֹ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת עֲרֹעֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·nū ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ’eṯ- dî·ḇōn wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ṭā·rōṯ wə·’êṯ ‘ă·rō·‘êr
verses.literal: And the Gadites . . . built up Dibon Ataroth Aroer
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Gade edificaram a Dibom, e Atarote, e Aroer;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַטְרֹ֥ת שׁוֹפָ֛ן וְאֶת־ יַעְזֵ֖ר וְיָגְבֳּהָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘aṭ·rōṯ šō·w·p̄ān wə·’eṯ- ya‘·zêr wə·yā·ḡə·bo·hāh
verses.literal: Atroth-shophan Jazer Jogbehah
verses.literalPt: E Atarote-Sofã, e Jazer, e Jogbeá;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית נִמְרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הָרָ֑ן עָרֵ֥י מִבְצָ֖ר וְגִדְרֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bêṯ nim·rāh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ hā·rān ‘ā·rê miḇ·ṣār wə·ḡiḏ·rōṯ ṣōn
verses.literal: Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran as fortified cities and they built folds for their flocks
verses.literalPt: E Bete-Ninra, e Bete-Harã, cidades fortes; e currais de ovelhas.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י רְאוּבֵן֙ בָּנ֔וּ אֶת־ חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָלֵ֑א וְאֵ֖ת קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên bā·nū ’eṯ- ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·lê wə·’êṯ qir·yā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The Reubenites . . . built up Heshbon Elealeh Kiriathaim
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Rúben edificaram a Hesbom, e Eleale, e Quiriataim;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ נְב֞וֹ וְאֶת־ בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ שִׂבְמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- nə·ḇōw wə·’eṯ- ba·‘al mə·‘ō·wn mū·sab·bōṯ šêm wə·’eṯ- śiḇ·māh way·yiq·rə·’ū ḇə·šê·mōṯ ’eṯ- šə·mō·wṯ he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer bā·nū
verses.literal: as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed and Sibmah And they renamed . . . - the cities they rebuilt
verses.literalPt: E Nebo, e Baal-Meom, mudando-lhes o nome, e Sibma; e os nomes das cidades que edificaram chamaram por outros nomes.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֑הָ וַיּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū bə·nê mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh gil·‘ā·ḏāh way·yil·kə·ḏu·hā way·yō·w·reš ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer- bāh
verses.literal: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, foram-se para Gileade, e a tomaram; e daquela possessão expulsaram os amorreus que estavam nela.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמָכִ֖יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên mō·šeh ’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ lə·mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh way·yê·šeḇ bāh
verses.literal: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh and they settled there
verses.literalPt: Assim Moisés deu Gileade a Maquir, filho de Manassés, o qual habitou nela.

verses.original: וְיָאִ֤יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת־ חַוֺּתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·’îr ben- mə·naš·šeh hā·laḵ way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- ḥaw·wō·ṯê·hem way·yiq·rā ’eṯ·hen ḥaw·wōṯ yā·’îr
verses.literal: Jair a descendant of Manasseh went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair
verses.literalPt: E foi Jair, filho de Manassés, e tomou as suas aldeias; e chamou-as Havote-Jair.

verses.original: וְנֹ֣בַח הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד אֶת־ קְנָ֖ת וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֧א לָ֦ה נֹ֖בַח בִּשְׁמֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·ḇaḥ hā·laḵ way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- qə·nāṯ wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯe·hā way·yiq·rā lāh nō·ḇaḥ biš·mōw
verses.literal: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages and called it Nobah after his own name
verses.literalPt: E foi Nobá, e tomou a Quenate com as suas aldeias; e chamou-a Nobá, segundo o seu próprio nome.
